# Design Language — "Clean Modern Ledger"

Calm, developer-product marketing, aligned with aisdkagents.com. A paper-textured muted canvas; left-aligned **ledger** heroes instead of centered billboards; large Geist Sans display titles carrying exactly one **pixel-type** phrase; soft squircle sheets lifted by `shadow-soft` rather than borders. Chrome is near-monochrome ink: CTAs are ink pills, and color lives only in artwork and component previews.

> One-liner for handing to another surface: Geist Sans for everything readable, Geist Pixel Square as the only display accent (one moment per section: a kicker _or_ an inline title phrase _or_ a numeral). Sentence case everywhere except pixel kickers. Wrap marketing bands in `BackgroundImageTexture variant="debut-light"` over `bg-canvas`; content column `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4`. Hero = left stack (`max-w-2xl`): trust chip → `SectionTitle as="h1" size="lg"` → `TwoToneSectionDescription size="xl"` with `ms-1 md:ms-1.5` → one `pillCtaClass.ink` pill, then a `rounded-[1.5rem] sm:rounded-[2rem] bg-card shadow-soft corner-squircle dark:bg-muted` stage. Cards are the same squircle + `shadow-soft`, `hover:shadow-soft-md`, no hard borders. Catalog items use the block & pattern card (16:10 preview → clamped title/description → pixel tag chips → hairline footer with muted brand icons and a 10px pixel `View →`) in a `bg-muted p-2 rounded-[1.5rem]` tray. One ink/accent pill per band; siblings use `pillCtaClass.muted` or `.outline`. Icons muted, `size-3`–`size-4`. Motion: soft shadow lifts, `active:scale-[0.99]` on pills, marquees off under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Never `transition-all`, never a centered SaaS hero, never a second display face.

The canonical implementation is the home hero: [`apps/www/components/landing/home-hero.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/home-hero.tsx) under [`apps/www/components/marketing-header.tsx`](apps/www/components/marketing-header.tsx), composed in [`apps/www/app/(app)/page.tsx`](<apps/www/app/(app)/page.tsx>). Reusable primitives: [`pill-cta.ts`](apps/www/components/pill-cta.ts), [`section-heading.tsx`](apps/www/components/section-heading.tsx), [`two-tone-section-description.tsx`](apps/www/components/two-tone-section-description.tsx), [`bg-image-texture.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/bg-image-texture.tsx). Tokens and utilities: [`apps/www/styles/globals.css`](apps/www/styles/globals.css).

**Scope.** This language governs the site: marketing surfaces (home, then pricing/landing pages) and the docs (see [Docs](#docs)). Home and docs are migrated; leftovers are listed under [Legacy surfaces](#legacy-surfaces-not-yet-migrated). Registry components under `apps/www/registry/` keep their own styling; this doc is about the site, not the components it ships.

---

## 1. Foundations

### Fonts — two voices

All loaded via `geist/font` in [`apps/www/app/layout.tsx`](apps/www/app/layout.tsx) and mapped in the `@theme inline` block of [`globals.css`](apps/www/styles/globals.css).

- **Geist Sans** (`font-sans`, `--font-geist-sans`) — the workhorse: titles, body, buttons, chips, nav. `antialiased` and `optimizeLegibility` are set on `body`. Display titles use weight **450**, never bold.
- **Geist Pixel Square** (`font-pixel-square`) — display accent only. **Budget: at most one pixel moment per section**, and it is one of:
  - a kicker via `PixelKicker` (`font-pixel-square text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-muted-foreground`)
  - an inline title phrase via `PixelPhrase` (≤ 4 words — e.g. the home hero's `expanded`)
  - a numeral or the footer wordmark
- **Card metadata exception:** inside [block & pattern cards](#block--pattern-cards), pixel type is also the micro-label voice: corner badges, tag chips, the overflow count, footer labels and the `View` affordance. Always `text-[10px]`, always muted (or the status color), never more than one or two words. This doesn't count against the section budget, which governs display type.
- **Banned for pixel:** body paragraphs, CTA labels, nav links, marketing chips outside cards, feature lists, form controls, anything needing fast parsing.
- **Geist Mono** (`font-mono`) — tiny uppercase eyebrows and install commands only (`font-mono text-[10px] tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground`). Not a third display voice.
- The other loaded pixel families (`font-pixel-grid`, `-circle`, `-triangle`, `-line`) are for registry demos and legacy sections. Do not use them on new marketing surfaces.

### Color — near-monochrome tokens

Semantic tokens only, defined as OKLCH in `:root` / `.dark` in [`globals.css`](apps/www/styles/globals.css). The neutrals follow the Vercel Geist gray scale: pure-white page, soft-white bands, `#171717` ink. They are strictly achromatic (chroma `0`), so no surface reads as blue- or warm-gray.

| Role                      | Token / class                                             | Light / dark        |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| Marketing band canvas     | `bg-canvas`                                               | `#FAFAFA` / `#0A0A0A` |
| App canvas (below bands)  | `bg-background`                                           | `#FFFFFF` / `#0A0A0A` |
| Sheets & cards            | `bg-card` → `dark:bg-muted`                               | `#FFFFFF` / `#1F1F1F` |
| Primary text              | `text-foreground`                                         | `#171717` / `#EDEDED` |
| Secondary text            | `text-muted-foreground`, or `text-foreground/55`–`/80`    | `#666666` / `#A1A1A1` |
| Soft fills                | `bg-muted/40`, `bg-muted/55`, `bg-muted/60`               | `#F5F5F5` / `#1F1F1F` |
| Primary CTA (ink)         | `bg-foreground text-background` → `pillCtaClass.ink`      | ink                 |
| Featured CTA (accent)     | `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` → `pillCtaClass.accent` | same ink as `foreground` in the default theme |
| Hairlines (when needed)   | `border-border/80`                                        | `#EBEBEB` / white 10% |

**Canvas vs muted:** `canvas` is a page surface (bands), and `muted` is a fill for chips, trays and wells. Never paint a whole band with `bg-muted`: at `#F5F5F5` against white sections it reads as gray. On the white band, sheets separate by `shadow-soft` alone, not by fill contrast.

**Accent budget:** one ink _or_ accent pill per band. Other CTAs in the same band use `pillCtaClass.muted`, `pillCtaClass.outline`, or a ghost text link.

**Hardcoded-color policy:** none in marketing chrome. Sanctioned exceptions: the complexity status colors on card badges (`text-emerald-600 / amber-600 / rose-600` with `dark:*-400`, always paired with the `BEG` / `INT` / `ADV` label so meaning never rides on color alone), the `--elevation-soft*` shadow RGB values, component preview screenshots in `apps/www/public/cult-pro-component-images/`, the dithered artwork, and brand marks. The lime `#ADFA1B` "new" badges and the `#006BFF` / `#FF6BFF` product tints are legacy and must not appear on new surfaces.

### Texture & artwork

- **Band texture:** `BackgroundImageTexture` ([`bg-image-texture.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/bg-image-texture.tsx)) with `variant="debut-light"`, `opacity={0.25}` on home. The client layer ([`background-texture-client.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/background-texture-client.tsx)) drops `debut-light` to `0.3` in dark mode.
- **Stage artwork:** a static dithered swirl, [`home-hero-artwork.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/home-hero-artwork.tsx) (`@paper-design/shaders-react` `Dithering`, `speed={0}`, `opacity-[0.14] dark:opacity-25 dark:invert`). Dither / halftone / pixel type are one motif family: use them together or not at all. Artwork never animates.

### Elevation

No borders on primary sheets and cards; lift comes from the soft-shadow scale. The values are CSS variables (with dark overrides) in [`globals.css`](apps/www/styles/globals.css), exposed as utilities through `@theme inline`:

| Utility          | Variable              | Use                                   |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `shadow-soft-sm` | `--elevation-soft-sm` | Chips, icon wells, small controls     |
| `shadow-soft`    | `--elevation-soft`    | Sheets, cards, preview tiles          |
| `shadow-soft-md` | `--elevation-soft-md` | Hover / selected state of the above   |

```css
/* light — shadow-soft */
0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06), 0 2px 4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04);
/* dark — shadow-soft */
0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 2px 4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3);
```

Always use the utility. Never re-inline these as `shadow-[…]` arbitrary values.

## 2. Surfaces & rounding

Large sheets use squircle corners: the `corner-squircle` utility in [`globals.css`](apps/www/styles/globals.css) (`corner-shape: squircle`, progressive: plain rounded corners where unsupported).

| Radius                               | Use                                         |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `rounded-md`                         | Focus-ring shape on text links; card tag chips and footer icon wells |
| `rounded-bl-md` / `rounded-br-md`    | Notched corner badges on card previews      |
| `rounded-xl`                         | Icon wells inside chips                     |
| `rounded-2xl`                        | Trust chips; block & pattern cards          |
| `rounded-[1.5rem]`                   | Card trays (`p-2`)                          |
| `rounded-3xl`                        | Preview tiles (marquee, grids)              |
| `rounded-[1.5rem] sm:rounded-[2rem]` | Primary marketing sheets / hero stage       |
| `rounded-full`                       | CTAs, nav pills, chip links                 |

Nesting: inner radius = outer radius − padding (e.g. `rounded-2xl` chip with `pl-1.5` holds a `rounded-xl` icon well).

**Hero stage / primary sheet**

```tsx
<div className="bg-card shadow-soft corner-squircle overflow-hidden rounded-[1.5rem] sm:rounded-[2rem] dark:bg-muted">
  <div className="relative">
    <HomeHeroArtwork />
    <div className="relative pt-8 pb-5 sm:pt-10 sm:pb-6">{/* marquee */}</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Preview tile / card**

```tsx
<Link className="bg-card shadow-soft hover:shadow-soft-md block overflow-hidden rounded-3xl transition-shadow duration-150 dark:bg-muted">
  <div className="relative aspect-[16/10]">{/* light + dark screenshots */}</div>
  <div className="flex h-11 items-center px-4 text-sm font-medium tracking-tight">Title</div>
</Link>
```

## 3. Typography patterns

| Element                       | Classes / primitive                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Hero title                    | `SectionTitle as="h1" size="lg"` → `text-4xl lg:text-[3.5rem] xl:text-[4rem] leading-none font-[450] tracking-[-0.06em] text-balance` |
| Section title                 | `SectionTitle` → `text-2xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl` + same weight/tracking                                  |
| Pixel phrase in title         | `PixelPhrase` → `font-pixel-square tracking-[-0.02em]`                                                      |
| Pixel kicker                  | `PixelKicker` → `font-pixel-square text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-muted-foreground`                 |
| Hero description              | `TwoToneSectionDescription size="xl"` → `text-xl leading-8 sm:text-2xl sm:leading-9 max-w-2xl tracking-tight text-balance` |
| Two-tone lead / rest          | `font-medium text-foreground` / `font-normal text-foreground/55`                                            |
| Card / tile title             | `text-sm font-medium tracking-tight` (tiles); `text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight` (large cards)          |
| Nav link                      | `text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground`                                                       |
| CTA label                     | `text-base font-medium` (hero pill), `text-sm` (header pill)                                                |
| Mono eyebrow                  | `font-mono text-[10px] tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground`                                      |
| Counts / prices               | always `tabular-nums`                                                                                        |

- **Optical indent:** descriptions under left-aligned titles get `ms-1 md:ms-1.5`.
- **Casing:** sentence case everywhere; uppercase only on pixel kickers and mono eyebrows.
- **Copy voice:** plain verbs, unpushy, and CTAs that name the outcome, with live counts where true: `Browse 137 components`, `Browse components`. Pixel phrases carry the product metaphor (`Shadcn, expanded`). No duplicate "Get started" buttons.

---

## 4. Layout & spacing

- **Band structure:** `MarketingHeader` (transparent, `h-16`) sits over the band. The band pulls up beneath it with `-mt-16 pt-16` so the texture runs behind the nav. The page root uses `overflow-x-clip` (not `overflow-hidden`) so future sticky elements keep working.
- **Content column:** `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4`. Hero copy `max-w-2xl`, `items-start text-start`.
- **Hero rhythm:** section `pt-8 pb-10 sm:pt-12 sm:pb-16 lg:pt-16 lg:pb-24`. Chip → `mt-6` title → `mt-3` description → `mt-8` CTA. Copy → stage `mb-8 sm:mb-12`.
- **Section rhythm (new sections):** `py-10 sm:py-16 lg:py-24`; header → content `mb-8 sm:mb-12`.
- **Alignment:** marketing sections are start-aligned. Centered heroes are banned.
- **First viewport stays sparse:** one chip, the title, the description, one CTA, the stage. No stat strips, pill clusters or extra cards above the fold.
- **Global header:** [`site-header.tsx`](apps/www/components/site-header.tsx) returns `null` on `/` (the home page renders the overlay `MarketingHeader` itself) and renders `MarketingHeader variant="docs"` everywhere else.

## 5. Components & motifs

- **Pill CTAs** — [`pillCtaClass`](apps/www/components/pill-cta.ts). Kept separate from `buttonVariants`. Base: `h-12 rounded-full px-6 text-base font-medium`, named transitions, `active:scale-[0.99]`, focus ring with offset. Variants: `ink` (default primary), `accent` (featured), `outline` (`bg-background shadow-soft`), `muted` (non-featured tiers). Modifiers: `trailingIcon` (`pl-6 pr-[1.375rem]`) when a `size-4` arrow follows the label, and `compact` (`h-9 px-4 text-sm`) in headers. The trailing arrow nudges `group-hover:translate-x-0.5`.
- **Marketing header** — [`MarketingHeader`](apps/www/components/marketing-header.tsx): wordmark (`cultLogoBasic` + `cult ui`), three links (Components; AI blocks ↗ and AI skills ↗ pointing at aisdkagents.com, each with a muted `ArrowUpRight size-3` and sr-only "opens in a new tab"), then `GitHubLink` and one compact ink pill. Uses `MobileNav` below `md`. No lime "new" badges.
- **Trust chip** — `bg-muted/55 shadow-soft-sm rounded-2xl h-9 pl-1.5 pr-3 text-sm backdrop-blur` with a `size-6 rounded-xl bg-background shadow-soft-sm` icon well; lead text `font-medium`, detail `text-muted-foreground hidden sm:inline`. One per hero, and it's a link.
- **Preview marquee** — two copies of the tile track using `animate-marquee` (`--duration:60s`, `--gap:1rem`, keyframes in `globals.css`). The duplicate copy is `aria-hidden` + `inert`. The track pauses on hover and on focus-within, and its edges fade with a horizontal `mask-image`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it's replaced by a static `sm:grid-cols-3` of the first three tiles.
- **Preview images** — paired `-demo-light.png` / `-demo-dark.png` screenshots toggled with `dark:hidden` / `hidden dark:block`, `object-cover object-top`, `aspect-[16/10]`.
- **Block & pattern cards** — the densest, most detailed surface in the language; see the dedicated section below.
- **Marketing sections** — [`MarketingSection`](apps/www/components/landing/marketing-section.tsx) (`mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-10 sm:py-16 lg:py-24`) and `SectionHeader` (optional `PixelKicker` → `SectionTitle` → `TwoToneSectionDescription` with the optical indent, an optional outline-pill `action` pinned right on `md`). Every home band below the hero is built from these. Label the `section` with `aria-labelledby` pointing at the header `id`.
- **Home page order** — hero (components) → new components → AI SDK Agents ("Built with Cult UI", the page's main ink pill, plus the Pro-customer discount chip) → Shift card demo → closing band → footer. The goal is traffic to AI SDK Agents. Cult Pro is being wound down in stages, so Cult UI copy presents the 58 former Pro components as new components and never says where they came from or that Pro is ending. Don't promote pro.cult-ui.com anywhere; the only links left are the footer's "Cult Pro downloads" and the discount chip, both aimed at existing buyers.
- **aisdkagents links** — always build them with [`aisdkAgentsUrl(path, { medium, content })`](apps/www/lib/aisdkagents.ts) so each placement carries `utm_source=cult-ui` plus its own `utm_medium` / `utm_content`. Never hardcode an aisdkagents.com URL.
- **Expandable tray** — [`ExpandableCatalogTray`](apps/www/components/landing/expandable-catalog-tray.tsx) shows the first 9 cards and an outline pill "Show N more {noun}" (`aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`). Use it when a catalog has more than one screen of items; link out instead when the full list lives elsewhere.
- **Connector motif** — in [`support-section.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/support-section.tsx): a `h-16 w-px bg-border/80` rule dropping from the closing CTA into a small terminal bump, leading to the next group (the studio's other products). Desktop only (`hidden md:inline-flex`), `aria-hidden`.
- **Footer** — [`footer.tsx`](apps/www/components/landing/footer.tsx): hairline `border-t`, start-aligned wordmark (`font-pixel-square text-lg font-bold`, the footer's one pixel moment), a one-line description, three link columns with 10px mono uppercase headings, and a hairline-divided legal row. Static, with no artwork.
- **Icons** — lucide for small chrome (`ArrowUpRight`), Hugeicons for marketing lists, brand marks from [`icons.tsx`](apps/www/components/icons.tsx). Stroke only, muted, `size-3`–`size-4`, `aria-hidden` when decorative.

### Block & pattern cards

The catalog card from aisdkagents.com: a screenshot on top, a tight text stack, and a footer ledger of metadata. It feels polished because of many small, consistent details: hairline dividers, notched corner badges, 10px pixel micro-labels, muted brand icons and a sliding `View` arrow. Built as [`CatalogCard`](apps/www/components/landing/catalog-card.tsx) (with `CatalogBadge`, `ComplexityBadge`, `CatalogMetaLabel` and `CatalogTray`); `size="sm"` for three-up grids, `size="md"` for two-up template rows. Use it for every browsable catalog item (components, blocks, templates) instead of hand-rolling the markup below.

**Anatomy, top to bottom**

1. **Preview** — `relative aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden bg-muted/20 border-b border-border/80`. Light and dark screenshots (`dark:hidden` / `hidden dark:block`), `object-cover object-top`, with a `group-hover:scale-[1.01]` drift over `duration-300`. If the image fails, show a centered pixel placeholder (`font-pixel-square text-[10px] tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground`, "Preview").
2. **Corner badge (optional, one per card)** — notched into a preview corner, flush to the edges:
   - Status / complexity, top-right: `absolute top-0 right-0 rounded-bl-md border-b border-l border-border/80 bg-background/95 px-2 py-1 backdrop-blur-sm` holding `font-pixel-square text-[10px] font-medium tracking-wider uppercase` in the status color (`BEG` emerald, `INT` amber, `ADV` rose).
   - New, top-left: the mirrored notch (`top-0 left-0 rounded-br-md border-r border-b`) on `bg-primary`, label `text-primary-foreground`.
3. **Body** — `flex flex-1 flex-col p-3` (compact grid) or `p-4` (two-up):
   - Title: `line-clamp-1 text-sm leading-tight font-medium tracking-tight` (`text-base` at `p-4`), `mb-1.5`.
   - Description: `line-clamp-2 flex-1 text-xs leading-relaxed font-light text-muted-foreground` (`text-sm` at `p-4`), `mb-3`. `flex-1` pushes the footer to a shared baseline across the row.
4. **Tags** — `flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-3`; at most 2 chips (4 on template cards), then an overflow count. Chip: `rounded-md border border-border/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-pixel-square text-[10px] lowercase text-muted-foreground group-hover:border-foreground/20`. Overflow: `font-pixel-square text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 px-1` → `+10`.
5. **Footer ledger** — `flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border/80 pt-2.5`:
   - Left: up to 5 dependency/brand icons, each in a `size-5 rounded-md border border-transparent` well with a `size-3` icon, `text-muted-foreground`, `hover:border-border hover:text-foreground`, and a tooltip naming it (pixel `text-[10px] uppercase`). Or a single uppercase pixel label (`Full-stack template`).
   - Right: `View` + `ArrowRight02Icon size-3`. `font-pixel-square text-[10px] tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground`, `group-hover:text-foreground`, arrow `group-hover:translate-x-0.5`.

**Recipe (in this language's tokens)**

```tsx
<a className="group bg-card shadow-soft hover:shadow-soft-md focus-visible:ring-ring relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl transition-shadow duration-150 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 dark:bg-muted">
  <div className="border-border/80 bg-muted/20 relative aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden border-b">
    {/* light/dark Image … */}
    {/* optional corner badge */}
  </div>
  <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-3">
    <h3 className="mb-1.5 line-clamp-1 text-sm leading-tight font-medium tracking-tight">Title</h3>
    <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-3 line-clamp-2 flex-1 text-xs leading-relaxed font-light">Description</p>
    {/* tags */}
    <div className="border-border/80 flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-2.5">
      {/* icons */}
      <span className="font-pixel-square text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] tracking-wider uppercase transition-colors">
        View <ArrowIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-3 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5 motion-reduce:group-hover:translate-x-0" />
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>
</a>
```

**Tray** — cards never float loose on the textured canvas. They sit in a muted tray: `grid gap-4 rounded-[1.5rem] bg-muted p-2 shadow-soft corner-squircle sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 dark:bg-background`. Concentric radii: tray `1.5rem` − `p-2` (0.5rem) = card `rounded-2xl` (1rem). If the tray padding changes, change the card radius with it.

**Budgets:** one corner badge per card; ≤ 2 tag chips + overflow count; ≤ 5 footer icons; title 1 line, description 2 lines; pixel type only at `text-[10px]` inside the card.

**Where the language tightens the aisdkagents source:** the originals use `border border-border rounded-xl`, `transition-all`, `group-hover:text-primary` on `View`, and a slightly larger `scale-[1.02]` on the dark image. `CatalogCard` uses `shadow-soft` in place of the border, `rounded-2xl`, named transitions, `text-foreground` on hover, and the same `1.01` drift in both themes.

### Docs

Docs pages are reading surfaces: white `bg-background` (no texture), no bands, the same tokens. Page shell in [`docs/[[...slug]]/page.tsx`](<apps/www/app/(app)/docs/[[...slug]]/page.tsx>); element styles in [`mdx-components.tsx`](apps/www/mdx-components.tsx).

- **Header** — `MarketingHeader variant="docs"`: sticky, full width (`lg:px-6`), `bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-md`, hairline `border-b`, `ModeToggle` as the trailing action, no ink pill. `inComponents` marks the Components link `aria-current`.
- **Page header** — `PixelKicker` with the sidebar category (the page's one pixel moment) → `SectionTitle as="h1"` (`text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl`) → description `text-lg text-foreground/55 max-w-2xl`. Actions sit right of the kicker: `DocsCopyPage` (soft pill split button) and `size-8 rounded-full bg-background shadow-soft-sm` previous/next icon buttons. Below `sm` they move into a fixed bottom bar.
- **Body** — `text-[0.9375rem] leading-relaxed text-foreground/80`. `h2` = `text-2xl font-[450] tracking-[-0.04em]` with a hairline `border-t pt-8` (none on the first); `h3` = `text-lg font-medium`. Links are `text-foreground` with a `decoration-foreground/25` underline that darkens on hover. Inline code `bg-muted rounded-md text-[0.8125em]`.
- **Sidebar** — [`docs-sidebar.tsx`](apps/www/components/docs-sidebar.tsx): section labels 10px mono uppercase, subgroup titles `text-[0.8125rem] font-medium`, items `h-8 rounded-lg text-[0.8125rem]` with `bg-muted font-medium` when active. `new` / `updated` / `recent` labels are monochrome pixel chips (`rounded-md border px-1 text-[10px] lowercase`); `new` gets `text-foreground`. No lime, cyan or pink.
- **Right rail** — [`docs-toc.tsx`](apps/www/components/docs-toc.tsx): 10px mono "On this page", a hairline `border-l` rail, and an IntersectionObserver-driven active item (`border-foreground text-foreground`, `aria-current="location"`). Below it one [`DocsPromoCard`](apps/www/components/docs-promo-card.tsx) for AI SDK Agents (squircle sheet, pixel micro-labels, one compact ink pill). No Cult Pro promo.
- **Preview** — [`component-preview-tabs.tsx`](apps/www/components/component-preview-tabs.tsx): `segmentedTabsClass` Preview/Code switch above a `rounded-[1.5rem] bg-background shadow-soft corner-squircle` stage (`p-4 md:p-10`); the Code tab swaps the stage to `bg-code`.
- **Segmented tabs** — [`segmentedTabsClass`](apps/www/components/segmented-tabs.ts): `bg-muted rounded-full p-1` list, `h-7 rounded-full` triggers, active `bg-background shadow-soft-sm`. Used for Preview/Code and the MDX `TabsList` (CLI/Manual).
- **Code** — `--code` tokens (`#FAFAFA` light, `#111` dark) with `--code-number` / `--code-highlight`. Figures are `rounded-2xl` with `shadow-soft-sm`, `0.8125rem` text, hairline title bar. [`CodeBlockCommand`](apps/www/components/code-block-command.tsx) is the same sheet with a mono package-manager row (underline on the active one) and an inline Copy button; the wrapping figure goes transparent around it. Long sources collapse behind a fade into `bg-code` with a soft "Expand code" pill.
- **Steps** — `Steps` draws a `border-l border-border/80` rail (`ml-3.5 pl-8`); each `h3` gets a `size-7` mono numeral in a `bg-background shadow-soft-sm` circle centered on the rail.
- **Tables** — `bg-background shadow-soft rounded-2xl` sheet, 10px mono uppercase headers on `bg-muted/40`, hairline row dividers, `text-[0.8125rem]` cells.
- **Callouts** — [`calloutClass`](apps/www/components/callout.tsx): `bg-muted/50 shadow-soft-sm rounded-2xl`, no border. MDX `Alert` uses it too.
- **Pager** — two `CatalogCard`-weight links (`bg-card shadow-soft rounded-2xl p-4`) under a hairline, 10px mono "Previous" / "Next" over the page name.

`cn` (in [`lib/utils.ts`](apps/www/lib/utils.ts)) registers `shadow-soft-sm` / `shadow-soft` / `shadow-soft-md` with tailwind-merge, so they override a component's default `shadow-*` instead of stacking with it.

---

## 6. Motion

| Moment          | Behavior                                                                                   |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Card/chip hover | `shadow-soft` → `shadow-soft-md` (or `-sm` → default) with `transition-shadow duration-150` |
| Card preview    | `group-hover:scale-[1.01]` over `duration-300` (the only scale-up in the language)          |
| Card details    | Tag border → `foreground/20`, `View` → `text-foreground`, arrow `translate-x-0.5`, all on card hover |
| Pill press      | `active:scale-[0.99]`, `motion-reduce:active:scale-100`                                    |
| Trailing arrow  | `group-hover:translate-x-0.5`, disabled under `motion-reduce`                               |
| Marquee         | `animate-marquee`; pauses on hover/focus; removed under `motion-reduce`                    |
| Artwork         | static (`speed={0}`)                                                                        |

Transitions name their properties (`transition-[transform,background-color,box-shadow,color]`, `transition-shadow`, `transition-colors`). **Never `transition-all`.** Every press, nudge and loop honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.

---

## 7. Checklist (per marketing page)

- [ ] Marketing bands wrapped in `BackgroundImageTexture variant="debut-light"` over `bg-canvas`
- [ ] Content in `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4`; hero copy start-aligned in `max-w-2xl` (no `text-center` / `items-center` hero)
- [ ] Titles use `SectionTitle` (weight 450, `tracking-[-0.06em]`, `leading-none`); hero uses `size="lg"`
- [ ] At most one `font-pixel-square` element per section, via `PixelKicker` or `PixelPhrase`; no other pixel family
- [ ] Descriptions use `TwoToneSectionDescription` with the optical indent under start-aligned titles
- [ ] Primary sheets: `rounded-[1.5rem] sm:rounded-[2rem] bg-card shadow-soft corner-squircle dark:bg-muted`, no `border`
- [ ] CTAs come from `pillCtaClass`; exactly one `ink` or `accent` pill per band
- [ ] Catalog items use the block & pattern card anatomy (preview → body → tags → footer ledger) inside a muted tray; one corner badge, ≤ 2 tags + count, ≤ 5 icons, clamped title/description
- [ ] Pixel type inside cards is `text-[10px]` micro-labels only; status badges pair color with a text label
- [ ] Counts and prices carry `tabular-nums`
- [ ] No hardcoded colors or arbitrary `shadow-[…]` in marketing chrome (exceptions in §1)
- [ ] Bands use `bg-canvas`, never `bg-muted`; neutrals stay achromatic (no `slate`/`zinc`/`stone` or tinted grays)
- [ ] Hover = soft-shadow step; press ≤ `scale-[0.99]` on pills; no `transition-all`; loops and nudges have a `motion-reduce` path
- [ ] Every link/button has an accessible name; external links announce the new tab; decorative icons are `aria-hidden`

## Planned patterns (from the aisdkagents spec, not yet built here)

Approved as direction but no code exists yet. Build them with the tokens above when the pages that need them are migrated, then move each one into §5 with a file link:

- **Pricing / choice cards** — the §2 sheet recipe with `p-5 sm:p-6`, `text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums` price, CTA pinned with `mt-auto`, featured = `pillCtaClass.accent`, others = `pillCtaClass.muted`.
- **FAQ shell** — `border border-border/80` + hairline shadow as the quieter secondary surface; `size-8 rounded-xl` icon wells; plus/minus toggle.
- **Answer / definition sheet** — sheet with `sm:grid-cols-[7.5rem_1fr]` rows, mono eyebrows, `border-b border-border/80` dividers.
- **Chip links** — `h-10 rounded-full bg-background shadow-soft-sm px-4 text-sm font-medium hover:shadow-soft active:scale-[0.96]`.
- **Entrance** — `animate-rise-in` (8px up + 4px blur + fade, `cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)`, ~0.5s). Not defined in `globals.css` yet.

Nothing on the home page imports them; delete them or rebuild with §5 primitives if another page needs them.
